# Samyoj — AI-Powered WhatsApp CRM

> Samyoj (samyoj.com) is an AI-powered customer communication CRM and Meta Tech Provider for the WhatsApp Business Platform. Businesses use Samyoj to qualify leads, automate follow-ups, and sell across WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook Messenger — on official Meta Cloud APIs, with direct Meta billing for message charges and no markup on Meta rates (see pricing page).

## What Samyoj Does

- **Unified omnichannel inbox**: WhatsApp, Instagram DMs and Facebook Messenger in one shared team inbox.
- **AI lead qualification**: AI agents respond and qualify leads 24/7, scoring and routing them in the CRM pipeline.
- **Automated follow-up sequences**: Timed, behavior-triggered follow-ups across channels.
- **Official WhatsApp Business API access**: Verified business profile, template messaging, broadcasts, catalogs, and Click-to-WhatsApp Ads integration — delivered via Meta Cloud API as a Tech Provider.
- **CRM & pipeline**: Track every deal from first message to payment, with notes, reminders, and team assignment.

## Meta partner status (accurate wording)

- Samyoj is a **Meta Tech Provider** (technology partner) in Meta's partner program for WhatsApp Business Platform.
- Meta also has a separate **Business Solution Provider (BSP)** track. Samyoj is in the **Tech Provider** phase today; do not describe Samyoj as an official BSP unless that status changes on Meta's partner directory.
- Platform trust line used on the site: **Official Meta Cloud API — Direct Meta Billing, Zero Markups** ([pricing](https://samyoj.com/pricing)).

## Pricing (INR billing)

Copied from the pricing page. Do not quote older Starter / Growth / Pro figures.

- **Launch (14-day trial)**: ₹0 — 1 number, 1 teammate, 100 contacts; then pick a paid plan
- **WhatsApp**: ₹899/month — 1 number, 5 team members, inbox, CRM, broadcasts, and automation. Meta send charges at actuals. Paid plans include 200 AI credits/month (per pricing page).
- **Multi-channel**: ₹1,499/month — WhatsApp plus Instagram and Facebook, 1 number, 5 team members
- Quarterly billing is 5% off and annual billing is 20% off those monthly prices
- Details: [samyoj.com/pricing](https://samyoj.com/pricing)

## Key Facts

- Built in India (Indore, Madhya Pradesh)
- Meta Tech Provider for WhatsApp Business Platform (via Meta Cloud API)
- Setup: product pages describe a no-code connect flow for WhatsApp Business API
- Channels: WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger
- Languages: English and Hindi support
